dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's all in the past. Don't get too hung up.

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: And what? Am I supposed to forgive and forget? How can they just get away with not paying me?

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: Hmph! I'll make sure they never trick anyone ever again — not as long as I'm here!
